reasons: Both answers correctly identify Catalan separation of property as the default, explain that the flat is not automatically half hers, cover the art. 232-5 compensation, and recommend a Catalan family lawyer. B is somewhat more useful: it gives the exact vecindad-change tests (10 years of residence, the declaration after 2 years), states the one-quarter cap correctly with its 'unless you prove more' exception, and adds the art. 231-9 protection of the family home and a warning about time limits and waivers. A is equally accurate but a little less complete.
